record.source_episode: Approved KSU tool workflow; executed upgraded system-property fixture and user-requested scoped qualification
record.trigger: Qualifying system-level rules or translating English obligations spanning multiple component contracts.
record.principle: Allocate each system obligation to responsible components, compose their guarantees under explicitly justified assumptions and schedules, and verify the generated system proof. Keep architecture, integration compatibility, system behavior and physical timing as separate checks. Qualify only the declared supported feature scope; report reviewed unsupported-tool and reference-coverage exclusions separately from failures.
record.semantic_choice: Component proofs and graph equivalence do not entail a system property. A missing reference contract establishes a coverage gap, not tool incapability.
record.structural_placement: System GUMBO composition with explicit schedule and assertion/invariant obligations; link local assume/guarantee ownership to system requirements.
record.repair_gate: Require executed applicable parser, architecture, integration, generated-code and system-proof checks plus a distinguishing negative control and required rule-transfer evidence. Retain excluded feature inventory with exact version; do not convert an exclusion into a verified unit.
prerequisites: Approved system English and data split
Explicit assumption ownership and abstract schedule
Reviewed exact qualification exclusions where applicable
exclusions: Inferring physical deadlines from abstract schedule proofs
Inferring full system behavior from graph isomorphism
Calling missing golden coverage a demonstrated tool limitation
Publishing rules from parser-only or unrelated tutorial evidence

parameters.name: system_obligation
parameters.constraints: Exact English and traced system assertion

parameters.name: schedule_assumptions
parameters.constraints: Explicit and justified; physical timing separate

target_compatibility: KSU HAMR SysML/GUMBO system properties with Sireum 4.20260810.80aad0c2
preserved_obligations: Supported in-scope requirements and mandatory gates
Original English inventory with excluded features retained
Negative and transfer evidence for rule applicability

counterexample.scenario: A model has equivalent architecture and valid local contracts, but an end-to-end system assertion is false.
counterexample.expected_difference: The system proof must reject it; architecture success cannot qualify that behavior.

record.notes: Session-curated unvalidated draft based on approved KSU tools context, user policy and executed development feedback. The official tutorial proves selected tool capability, not this rule generalization or Isolette acceptance. No new training material or paid model extraction.

misleading_near_matches: all components typecheck so the system requirement is proven
